adjudication.rationale: The diff introduces verifiable correctness/security issues in the new addGuests flow. In `addGuests.handler.ts`, `isTeamAdminOrOwner` is computed with `&&` between `isTeamAdmin(...)` and `isTeamOwner(...)`, meaning only users who are *both* admin and owner pass that branch (likely unintended given the variable name, and it will wrongly forbid plain admins/owners). Also, the blacklist is normalized to lowercase (`BLACKLISTED_GUEST_EMAILS.split(...).map(email => email.toLowerCase())`) but incoming `guest` emails are compared without lowercasing (`!blacklistedGuestEmails.includes(guest)`), allowing case-variant bypass. Additionally, the handler updates attendees and calendars without any booking status/eligibility check (no check of booking state/time), so adding guests could occur for cancelled/past bookings if allowed by permissions. These are concrete issues present in the diff; the 'zero tests' point is also supported by no test changes in the diff, but the above defects make this more than just a testing concern.
